name: flexAlignCenter
verdict: two VBCE pages of the same Grid control disagree and one of them is garbled: the Grid Constants page prints flexAlignLeft 0 / flexAlignRight 1 / flexAlignCenter 2 for the ColAlignment property, while the ColAlignment property page prints flexAlignCenter 0 / flexAlignLeft 1 / flexAlignRight 2 carrying the CellAlignment enum's descriptions ("Left top", "Left center", "Left bottom"). The corpus alone cannot say which mapping the eVB runtime used -- no value is resolved and both tables stay quoted.

name: NERR_DCNotFound
verdict: the Alphabetical Order error tables print 243, the Numerical Order tables print 2453; the numerical sequence around it is contiguous (2452 NERR_LastAdmin, 2453 NERR_DCNotFound, 2454 next) and lmerr.h of the public-domain w32api prints (NERR_BASE+353) = 2453. The alphabetical copies repeat the truncated code in every generation.

name: RTCEF_GROUP
verdict: the CE 6.0 page prints the name twice in one enum list: in alphabetical order as 'RTCEF_GROUP = 0x00002000' and again, out of order directly after 'RTCEF_INVITE = 0x02000000', as 'RTCEF_GROUP = 0x02000000' (the same number RTCEF_INVITE carries). The CE 4.x and CE 5.0 pages print only 0x00002000, four rows to one.

name: TMMS_DEFAULT_TF
verdict: one page prints one name twice: the WZC_CONTEXT tmTf member sentence prints 'TMMS_DEFAULT_TF (0x0000ea60)' and the tmTd member sentence prints 'TMMS_DEFAULT_TF (0x00001388)' where the member name shows a td default was meant (the page lists tmTr/tmTc/tmTp/tmTf/tmTd and prints TMMS_DEFAULT_TR/TC/TP/TF beside them; no TMMS_DEFAULT_TD exists). 0x0000ea60 is the tmTf default on both the CE 5.0 and CE 6.0 copies; the page itself states 'Default values are defined in Wzcsapi.h'.
